skillStudio.create.basicsDescription.zh-CN: 为技能命名并设置可安全用于路由的 Slug。

skillStudio.create.description.en: Create an editable company skill and open it directly in Studio.
skillStudio.create.description.zh-CN: 创建可编辑的公司技能，并直接在工作室中打开。

skillStudio.create.editableBody.zh-CN: 现在可以在 Paperclip CN 工作区中编辑 {{name}}。

skillStudio.create.forkSourceNotFound.en: Fork source not found. You can still create a blank skill.
skillStudio.create.forkSourceNotFound.zh-CN: 找不到复制来源。你仍可创建空白技能。

skillStudio.create.taglinePlaceholder.en: Review repository changes for correctness, tests, and maintainability.
skillStudio.create.taglinePlaceholder.zh-CN: 审查仓库变更的正确性、测试情况和可维护性。

skillStudio.files.confirmDiscard.en: Discard unsaved edits and switch files?
skillStudio.files.confirmDiscard.zh-CN: 放弃未保存的编辑并切换文件？

skillStudio.files.createDescription.en: Saved changes create a new version immediately. External sources are not updated until you publish or install an update.
skillStudio.files.createDescription.zh-CN: 保存更改后会立即创建新版本。发布或安装更新前，外部来源不会同步更新。

skillStudio.files.deleteFolderDescriptio.en: This removes every skill file under the folder and saves the result as the next version.
skillStudio.files.deleteFolderDescriptio.zh-CN: 此操作会移除该文件夹下的所有技能文件，并将结果保存为下一个版本。

skillStudio.files.editCopyDescription.en: Make an editable copy to change it — the original stays untouched.
skillStudio.files.editCopyDescription.zh-CN: 创建可编辑副本后再修改，原始技能将保持不变。

skillStudio.files.empty.en: This skill has no files yet.

skillStudio.files.fileExists.en: A file already exists at that path.

skillStudio.files.folderEmpty.en: No files exist under that folder.

skillStudio.files.folderExists.en: A folder already exists at that path.
skillStudio.files.folderExists.zh-CN: 该路径下已存在文件夹。

skillStudio.files.folderSeedDescription.en: A README.md seed file is created so the folder appears in the file tree.
skillStudio.files.folderSeedDescription.zh-CN: 系统会创建一个 README.md 初始文件，使该文件夹显示在文件树中。

skillStudio.files.readOnlyReason.en: This skill is read-only because it comes from an external source.
skillStudio.files.readOnlyReason.zh-CN: 此技能来自外部来源，因此为只读。

skillStudio.files.unsavedWarning.en: Unsaved edits live only in this Studio session. Save to create the next version before running tests or switching files.
skillStudio.files.unsavedWarning.zh-CN: 未保存的编辑仅保留在当前工作室会话中。请先保存以创建新版本，再运行测试或切换文件。

skillStudio.fork.createdAndSwitched_othe.en: Created a copy of {{name}} and switched {{count}} agents to it.

skillStudio.fork.description.en: {{name}} is read-only because it comes from an external source. Creating a fully editable copy in your workspace leaves the original untouched and still updatable.
skillStudio.fork.description.zh-CN: {{name}} 来自外部来源，因此为只读。在工作区中创建可完全编辑的副本不会改动原始技能，原始技能仍可继续更新。

skillStudio.fork.existingCopyMessage.zh-CN: 此技能已有一个尚未编辑的副本。请打开该副本，而不是重复创建。

skillStudio.fork.noAgentsUse.zh-CN: 当前没有智能体使用此技能

skillStudio.fork.noAssignments.en: Nothing is assigned to it, so your copy won't change any agent's behavior.
skillStudio.fork.noAssignments.zh-CN: 此技能尚未分配给任何智能体，因此副本不会改变任何智能体的行为。

skillStudio.fork.switchAgents.en: Switch these agents to the copy
skillStudio.fork.switchAgents.zh-CN: 将这些智能体切换到副本

skillStudio.fork.switchAgentsOff.en: These agents keep running the original; your copy won't change what they do.
skillStudio.fork.switchAgentsOff.zh-CN: 这些智能体将继续使用原始技能；你的副本不会改变它们的行为。

skillStudio.fork.switchAgentsOn.en: These agents will run your copy instead of the original.
skillStudio.fork.switchAgentsOn.zh-CN: 这些智能体将改用你的副本，而不是原始技能。
